نشمأزز (form IVq)
# نَشْمَأْزِزْ (našmaʔziz) /naʃ.maʔ.ziz/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# نُشْمَأْزَزْ (nušmaʔzaz) /nuʃ.maʔ.zaz/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
